summary.building: Configurable OpenSea-minted Yield Banks with manually allocated Stock Token, USDG, and Delta v3 backing
summary.topRisk: Mutable external SeaDrop, asset implementation, oracle, route, and indexer configuration must remain release-bound and monitored
summary.mustDecideFirst: The first collection's supply, economics, eligibility policy, assets, feeds, pool, and role addresses
summary.watchOutFor: Creator royalties are optional, Stock Token eligibility is external, and no audit can guarantee zero defects

risks.title: Alternate mint path or wrong payout
risks.detail: Every enumerable mint authorization and the proceeds-vault payout must match the manifest.

risks.title: Premature ownership handoff
risks.detail: OpenSea Studio setup must finish before Ownable2Step control is accepted by the timelock.

risks.title: Optional secondary royalties
risks.detail: ERC-2981 and an OpenSea setting do not enforce payment across marketplaces.

risks.title: Network and dependency mixing
risks.detail: A testnet RPC with mainnet dependency addresses targets the wrong system.

risks.title: Public RPC throttling
risks.detail: Rate limits can cause incomplete reads and monitoring failures.

risks.title: Multiplier accounting error
risks.detail: Raw balances stay static while corporate actions change uiMultiplier and the adjusted onchain price.

risks.title: External eligibility restrictions
risks.detail: Securities eligibility and jurisdiction rules require an explicit reviewed policy.

risks.title: REST and onchain price mismatch
risks.detail: REST prices are unadjusted while onchain feeds are multiplier-adjusted.

risks.title: Public terminology restriction
risks.detail: External copy must say Stock Tokens rather than tokenized stocks or equities.

risks.title: Implementation drift
risks.detail: Proxy runtime alone does not identify active USDG behavior.

risks.title: Slippage and tick manipulation
risks.detail: Manual position operations require protected floors, ranges, and deadlines.

risks.title: Dependency or route drift
risks.detail: Builder, factory, manager, pool, and routes must match reviewed runtime hashes.

risks.title: Position NFT custody
risks.detail: Untracked or unsolicited position NFTs can strand backing.

risks.title: Invalid or stale price
risks.detail: Incomplete, nonpositive, future, or stale rounds corrupt NAV and safety floors.

risks.title: Feed binding drift
risks.detail: A changed feed address can price the wrong asset.

risks.title: Clone initialization or salt mistake
risks.detail: Incorrect initialization can bind the wrong NFT account.

risks.title: Custom ERC721 hook behavior
risks.detail: Mint, transfer, and burn paths require lifecycle tests.

risks.title: Unsimulated calldata
risks.detail: Typed data can still revert unless simulated with the actual account and value.

risks.title: Receipt or replacement misclassification
risks.detail: A transaction hash alone is not successful execution.

risks.title: Wrong connected wallet chain
risks.detail: Configured default chain does not prove the wallet's current chain.

risks.title: Stale WalletConnect session
risks.detail: Older sessions may not authorize Robinhood Chain.

risks.title: Missing event declaration
risks.detail: Unconfigured events are silently absent from indexed state.

risks.title: Wrong address or start block
risks.detail: History remains incomplete after a full reindex.

risks.title: RPC auth limitation
risks.detail: Pinned 3.2.1 lacks documented v3.3 custom-header support.

risks.title: Concentrated liquidity slippage
risks.detail: Zero or weak minimum amounts expose LP operations to value loss.

risks.title: Position custody
risks.detail: The ERC721 position ID and approvals must remain tracked.

risks.title: Out-of-range exposure drift
risks.detail: Positions become single-sided and stop earning when out of range.

preCodingDecisions.title: Collection configuration
preCodingDecisions.detail: Choose supply, prices, proceeds splits, sleeve weights, royalty rate, roles, and policy caps per collection.

preCodingDecisions.title: Eligibility and assets
preCodingDecisions.detail: Choose the reviewed eligibility policy, Stock Tokens, feeds, USDG, INJOH, and Delta pool.

preCodingDecisions.title: Operational infrastructure
preCodingDecisions.detail: Choose managed RPCs, Envio deployment/start block, and monitoring thresholds.

preCodingDecisions.title: Independent audit
preCodingDecisions.detail: Complete an external audit and record its hash before activation.

requirementsCorrections.detail: SeaDrop buyers pay native ETH; WETH is used after payout for internal backing allocation.
Secondary royalties are optional and cannot be represented as guaranteed revenue.
The first collection still needs explicit eligibility, assets, feeds, pool, routes, roles, and economics.
Supply, economics, policy caps, royalties, and deterministic deployment bindings are fixed per deployed collection.
